Mear Roofing & Exteriors LLC

Knoxville Roofing & Exterior Contractor

Roofing · Siding · Windows · Doors · Decks

With over 40 years in the roofing and exteriors industry, Mear Roofing & Exteriors is your go-to contractor for every exterior need in Knoxville and the surrounding area — from a full roof replacement to a storm repair, new siding, replacement windows or a custom deck.

As a family-owned business, we build lasting relationships with our customers. Our hands-on approach means the owner is on every job, so you always know exactly who is working on your home — and we stay in constant communication until the job is done.

  • Owner on every job
  • Free, no-pressure estimates
  • Insurance claims welcome
  • Quality, name-brand materials

FAQs

Choosing a Roofing Company in Knoxville

Do you offer free roof inspections and estimates?

Yes. Call 865-456-7890 or fill out the form and we'll schedule a free inspection and give you a clear, written estimate.

Do you work with insurance companies?

Yes, insurance claims are welcome. We document storm and hail damage, help you through the claim and can meet with your adjuster.

What warranty do you offer?

Our installations come with a lifetime installation warranty, in addition to the manufacturer's material warranty. [Confirm warranty terms]

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. Mear Roofing & Exteriors LLC is licensed, bonded and insured. [Confirm TN license #12468 & insurance carrier]

What services do you provide besides roofing?

Siding installation and repair, replacement windows and doors, and custom decks, so you can handle your whole exterior with one contractor.

What areas do you serve?

Knoxville, Farragut, Karns, Lenoir City, Loudon, Tellico Village and the surrounding East Tennessee area.
